summary: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Registration Rights Agreement, a Management Agreement, and a $1.0 billion senior secured revolving credit facility, all in connection with its initial public offering of common stock completed on May 15, 2026. The agreements were entered into on May 15, 2026, with affiliated entities Blackstone Treasury Holdings III L.L.C. and BX REIT Advisors L.L.C. as well as the Operating Partnership. No price per share, premium, or deal terms are disclosed. The filing reflects routine IPO-related documentation and financing arrangements, not a special situation. No risk-arb angle exists.
